### Media Organizer Pro
- Type: automation
- Description: Advanced media management using FFmpeg automation and machine learning
- Details: Professional-grade media organization tool leveraging FFmpeg for video/audio processing, ML-based content classification, automated metadata extraction, and intelligent file categorization.
- Technologies: Python, FFmpeg, Machine Learning, OpenCV, PyQt
- Repository: https://github.com/mahamed-yasser/media-organizer-pro

### Smart File Organizer
- Type: tool
- Description: GUI desktop application for automatic file organization and categorization
- Details: Cross-platform desktop application with drag-and-drop interface, custom folder rules, batch processing, and real-time preview. Features intelligent file type detection and automatic naming conventions.
- Technologies: Python, Tkinter, OS Module, Shutil
- Repository: https://github.com/mahamed-yasser/Smart-File-Organizer

### Task & Notes App
- Type: web
- Description: Responsive task manager with real-time search and persistent storage
- Details: Modern web application featuring real-time task filtering, category management, statistics dashboard, dark/light theme support, and local storage persistence for offline access.
- Technologies: JavaScript, CSS Grid, Flexbox, LocalStorage
- Repository: https://github.com/mahamed-yasser/my-first-app
